skills.name: documents
skills.description: Create, edit, redline, and verify Word or DOCX documents where page layout matters.

skills.name: pdf
skills.description: Read, create, inspect, render, and verify PDF files, including fillable AcroForms.

skills.name: spreadsheets
skills.description: Create, modify, analyze, and visualize XLSX, CSV, or TSV spreadsheet files with formulas, formatting, and charts.

skills.name: presentations
skills.description: Read, create, or edit PowerPoint and slide deck presentations with visual layout verification.

skills.name: imagegen
skills.description: Generate or edit raster images, illustrations, textures, mockups, and transparent-background cutouts.

skills.name: security-audit
skills.description: Audit a repository or scoped component for security vulnerabilities and exploitable attack paths.

skills.name: code-review
skills.description: Review a code change for correctness, regressions, maintainability, and missing validation.
